style_en: 白い何もない空間に置いたミニチュアの模型（ジオラマ）の3DCG。人物は顔の細かい所が無い、つるんとしたフィギュア。色は白と灰色が中心で、大事な物（風船）だけ赤

cuts.image: 灰色の雨雲の下、赤い風船が街の模型に降ってくる
cuts.image_en: a miniature 1980s city diorama in the lower half of the frame with gray office towers; under a low dark gray rain cloud, hundreds of small red and white balloons are falling down onto the roofs and streets, light rain streaks, gloomy mood
cuts.en: a miniature 1980s city diorama in the lower half of the frame with gray office towers; under a low dark gray rain cloud, hundreds of small red and white balloons are falling down onto the roofs and streets, light rain streaks, gloomy mood

cuts.image: 湖のほとりの工業の街のジオラマ
cuts.image_en: a miniature diorama of a 1980s industrial American lakeside city in the middle of the frame: gray office towers, old factory chimneys with no smoke, a wide gray lake in front, overcast soft light, seen from slightly above
cuts.en: a miniature diorama of a 1980s industrial American lakeside city in the middle of the frame: gray office towers, old factory chimneys with no smoke, a wide gray lake in front, overcast soft light, seen from slightly above

cuts.image: 白い台座の上の金色のトロフィーに赤い風船が1つ
cuts.image_en: a shiny gold trophy model with no text on a white pedestal in the middle of the frame, one red balloon tied to it floating just above, spotlight from above
cuts.en: a shiny gold trophy model with no text on a white pedestal in the middle of the frame, one red balloon tied to it floating just above, spotlight from above

cuts.image: 白いTシャツの高校生のフィギュアたちが風船をふくらませる
cuts.image_en: a row of teenage figurines with smooth featureless faces in plain white t-shirts and jeans stand at tables with gray helium tanks in the lower-middle of the frame, each filling a red balloon, many filled balloons floating behind them, empty white space above their heads
cuts.en: a row of teenage figurines with smooth featureless faces in plain white t-shirts and jeans stand at tables with gray helium tanks in the lower-middle of the frame, each filling a red balloon, many filled balloons floating behind them, empty white space above their heads

cuts.image: 足場の箱の網の下に、赤い風船がぎっしり
cuts.image_en: seen from above, a huge box-shaped frame of gray steel scaffolding in a city square in the middle of the frame, its open top closed by one big white mesh net, packed full of red and white balloons pressing against the net
cuts.en: seen from above, a huge box-shaped frame of gray steel scaffolding in a city square in the middle of the frame, its open top closed by one big white mesh net, packed full of red and white balloons pressing against the net

cuts.image: 広場の上空に、西から灰色の雨雲が迫る
cuts.image_en: a miniature city square diorama with the big net box of balloons in the lower-middle of the frame; from the left side a huge dark gray rain cloud approaches over the city, tense mood
cuts.en: a miniature city square diorama with the big net box of balloons in the lower-middle of the frame; from the left side a huge dark gray rain cloud approaches over the city, tense mood

cuts.image: 赤い上着の男が腕時計を見て片手を上げる
cuts.image_en: a faceless man figurine with short curly brown hair in a plain red windbreaker stands in the lower-middle of the frame, checking a plain wristwatch and raising one hand to give a signal; the net box full of balloons behind him, a dark cloud on the horizon, empty space above his head
cuts.en: a faceless man figurine with short curly brown hair in a plain red windbreaker stands in the lower-middle of the frame, checking a plain wristwatch and raising one hand to give a signal; the net box full of balloons behind him, a dark cloud on the horizon, empty space above his head

cuts.image: 白い空間に赤い風船が1つと、その上に小さな雨雲
cuts.image_en: one single red balloon floating in the middle of the white space, a small dark gray rain cloud model hovering just above it, simple centered composition
cuts.en: one single red balloon floating in the middle of the white space, a small dark gray rain cloud model hovering just above it, simple centered composition

cuts.image: 雨のしずくの付いた赤い風船が、ふくらんだまま屋根へ沈んでいく（前の絵 a08 から切り替える）
cuts.image_en: close view in the middle of the frame: several red balloons, still fully inflated and covered in cold rain droplets, are being pushed down toward gray rooftops below, rain streaks
cuts.en: close view in the middle of the frame: several red balloons, still fully inflated and covered in cold rain droplets, are being pushed down toward gray rooftops below, rain streaks

cuts.image: 滑走路に赤い風船が散らばり、小さな飛行機が止まる
cuts.image_en: a small airport runway diorama on a lakeshore in the middle of the frame, many red and white balloons scattered across the gray runway, a small plain white propeller plane with no markings waiting at the end
cuts.en: a small airport runway diorama on a lakeshore in the middle of the frame, many red and white balloons scattered across the gray runway, a small plain white propeller plane with no markings waiting at the end
